methodologyNotes: Evaluation suite executes 12 deterministic benchmark fixtures with exact numerical and schema assertions.
Separates deterministic computational verification from model-graded evaluations.
All tests run offline against version-controlled local fixtures without external network calls.
Denominator transparency: each metric rate reports its exact sample denominator in metrics.denominators.
disclaimersAndLimitations: CRITICAL INTERPRETATION: 12/12 passing benchmark cases confirms that all 12 current deterministic regression fixtures passed their exact assertions.
It does NOT claim or imply that open-domain or production analytical accuracy is 100%.

The evaluation suite covers 12 targeted categories (numeric_accuracy, metric_resolution, schema_compatibility, python_statistics, evidence_traceability, causation_restraint, small_sample_communication, security_prompt_injection, security_unsafe_sql, missing_values_and_empty_data, artifact_generation, failure_handling_and_recovery).

Deterministic fixtures measure baseline regressions against known edge cases; real-world queries introduce unconstrained vocabulary, multi-table joins, and noisy data distributions requiring ongoing operational telemetry.
